name: dial
title: Dial
description: A slider wound into a ring: one track that carries a curl from a straight bar to a ring, its max end level at twelve o'clock, so turning anticlockwise lowers the value. Marks and ticks ride the track; the slider's knob turns round it; the centre holds a readout. Drag round or along, wheel, or the slider keys. Winding runs on the surface spring.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/dial.md. SwiftUI: not yet (planned: MetalDial).
